title: Audit every feature that rediscovers state by scanning session.messages — tail hydration invalidated the residency assumption
outcome:
PATTERN BEAD, third instance in one day (2026-07-30). tm-9sf slices A+B replaced full-transcript hydration with a bounded 20-message tail. Any code that RE-DISCOVERS state by scanning session.messages silently changed meaning: it now searches a window, not a transcript, and returns null/absent instead of the truth. No compile error, no test failure — the scan is still 'correct', its input shrank.

CONFIRMED INSTANCES: tm-1q1 (findLastUserPromptInMessages -> working-turn hint disappears once a turn emits 20+ messages; measured zero user prompts in the tail of BOTH live active sessions). tm-hna (adjacent shape: the tail WIRE projection inherited a metadata-only builder and dropped pendingPrompts).

TASK: enumerate every consumer that derives state by scanning a session's message array and classify each as (a) safe — only needs recent messages, (b) broken — needs an arbitrarily old message, or (c) needs an explicit field instead. Start from grep for session.messages / activeSessionMessages / messages.length / findLast / reduceRight / for-loops-backward across ui/src. Known candidates to check explicitly: last-user-prompt derivations (findLastUserPrompt and findLastUserPromptInMessages have TWO callers), latest-assistant-text scans (the Telegram forwarding cursor uses one server-side — verify whether its bound is now a window too), conversation-marker index hints, search-index construction, overview-rail summaries, message-count-derived UI gates, and anything computing 'first message' or 'session start'.

RULE TO ADOPT AND RECORD: features must not depend on transcript residency. State the UI needs continuously (current turn prompt, current command, first-message identity, counts) should be carried as an explicit field or fetched deliberately — never rediscovered by scanning whatever happens to be loaded. Add this to the tm-9sf design notes and dev-team-pattern.md so the remaining hydration slices are written against it rather than discovering it one bug report at a time.

Cross-reference: tm-9sf (epic), tm-9sf.1 (jump-to-start, same family — the boundary jump assumed the loaded window was the transcript), tm-hna, tm-1q1, tm-qt5 (verify against reality, not fixtures).
